anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Making peace through the blood of his cross.

pass_a_gloss: through which offering of his a wandering world is being cleansed, coming into a turning, and he makes-peace the all things in the blood of his cross, the enmity having been killed, which is wrath into destruction of those disobeying.
pass_b_english: through which offering of his a wandering world is being cleansed, coming to turning, and he makes peace of all things in the blood of his cross, the enmity having been killed, which is wrath for the destruction of those who disobey.
source_text: δι’ ἧς προσφορᾶς αὐτοῦ καθαρίζεται|| πλανώμενος κόσμος εἰς ἐπιστροφὴν ἐρχόμενος, καὶ εἰρηνοποιεῖ τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ στ(αυ)ροῦ αὐτοῦ, ἀποκτανθείσης τῆς ἔχθρας, ἥτις ἐστὶν ὀργὴ εἰς ὀλέθρευσιν τῶν ἀπειθούντων.
